notes.title: Player Profile refresh. Team Roles and member promotions update.
notes.content: Player Profile refresh. Team Roles and member promotions update.

notes.title: Team Update: Members can be promoted, and points can be assigned
notes.content: Team Leaders can now promote/demote team members. They can also assign/remove Team points.

notes.title: Big Weekly Update
notes.content:
New: Player Level-up sequence
Fixes: various UI fixes an improvements when spectating or playing in a 2v2 Match
Fix: AI will now play in the bottom row of the board
Prep: Adam Koralic
Prep: Steam Achievements
Lower: Chat costs
UI: Show Game Mode in pre-match screen
Perf: reduce "hitches" in gameplay from server events
Balance: Prefer AI closer in level to Players

notes.title: Fix: Boom Box display
notes.content: Fixed a bug where Boom Boxes might not display properly, could blink, or just not show up.

notes.title: Launch Update
notes.content:
Update: AI won't relentlessly call in Nuclear Strikes back-to-back
Fix: Chat icon for spectating a player's current Match
Nice: Players now get a free pack of cards if they are online during a server update
Fix: Players can now call in up to 3 Nuclear Strikes
